notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (search-centric product) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Primary goal: replace current slow vector pipeline and eliminate heavy infra ops.

POC scope and outcomes: quickstart used Hosted API for proof-of-concept ingestion (250k sample docs). They ran nightly batch jobs (approx 2–3M tokens per night). Observed: average embed time fine, but large batch tail latency spikes at >16k docs/upload. POC team wants deterministic throughput for nightly re-index and a predictable per-embedding unit cost.

Throughput & performance targets: target indexing window is 2 hours for nightly re-index of ~1M short docs (avg 150 tokens). That maps to ~140 embeds/sec sustained (parallelized). For online search, 95th percentile latency target for nearest-neighbor time per query is <50ms (end-to-end). Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, want to avoid >$120k ARR for infra alone.

Vector DB & integration: currently testing Pinecone (managed) and Milvus (self-hosted). Primary integration path: Redwood-hosted embeddings -> vector DB (Pinecone) for nearest-neighbor. Also evaluating a flow with Redwood Dedicated + in-cluster Milvus to cut network egress. SE notes: prefer simple SDK integration and built-in batching helpers.

Model and feature asks: 1) high-quality embeddings (open models ok) with dimensionality ~1536; 2) deterministic batching and KV-cache friendly options for consistent perf; 3) streaming for incremental index builds; 4) tags/metadata passthrough for vectors to support filtering.

Security & compliance: SOC2 required, SSO via SAML, audit logging for embed/index events, KMS for key material, explicit data residency for EU customers. They asked about on-prem/private control plane later in roadmap.

Commercial: they want Hosted API pricing for initial POC, then a Dedicated reserved band when steady-state usage justifies it. Price sensitivity around per-embedding unit and token egress to Pinecone. Asked for a dedicated pricing model example for 8 GPUs reserved vs. burst capacity.

Quotes/Call snippets: "If we can get nightly re-index to finish inside our window without maintaining a fleet, we're sold on moving to Dedicated." CTO.

Open action items: 1) Provide Dedicated pricing scenarios (monthly committed vs burst), include example total cost of ownership vs self-hosted Milvus. 2) SE to run an optimized batch test on Dedicated baseline (Priya). 3) Security to receive SOC2 + KMS integration notes (Jordan to send documents). 4) Confirm Pinecone egress impact with finance (billing model).

Blockers: budget committee review (Feb), vector-db selection uncertainty, one spike incident during POC (logs attached).
